description: Hands in a post on X that boosts a paper competition entry: a boosted entry ranks by its gain times 1.1 (a loss counts as it is; the +10% bar to win is held to the gain itself). The post must be from the X handle the entry joined with, hold #LoomDeskComp and the entry's code (the competition page shows both), and be posted after the entry joined. Use once, after posting; an entrant's bot may post the text itself and hand the link in here. Returns: boosted, x (the entry's handle), post (the id that counts), already (true when the entry was boosted before). Behavior: writes; no key needed, since only the post's author's entry can gain; only the post's id is sent to X; the post is read again when the standings freeze, and one taken down by then counts for nothing. Costs 2 units. Errors: refused when the post cannot be read, is a repost, lacks the tag or the code, is from a handle with no entry, or predates the entry.

post.description: The post's link (https://x.com/<handle>/status/<number>) or its id.

name: arena_comp_boost
title: Boost a competition entry with a post on X
